chat.author: Frank Brockners
chat.text:
@Laurent: There are some benchmarking results on various TSFM mentioned at https://github.com/splunk/cisco-time-series-model
A more general, non networking specific TSFM benchmark is GIFT-eval: https://huggingface.co/spaces/Salesforce/GIFT-Eval

chat.author: Frank Brockners
chat.text: The main beauty of transformer based time series foundational models is that you don't have to fit a model to a use-case or deployment (which is what you had to do with linear models like S-ARIMA or LSTM, like what was discussed in the session). "One size fits all" starts to become a reality.

chat.author: Christopher Janz
chat.text: My question about this last draft is that it nominally covers the same topic - AI agents  in network management architecture - as the NMA draft in NMOP. I personally like this draft, and I am happy to support it, in most respects I find it clearer and with more useful detailed content than the other. Still, we should have either one draft on a topic across the organization, or a checked complementarity that is more apparent in the title and description.
